slide1.headline: Google Signs EU AI Act Code of Practice
slide1.subtitle: Transparency in AI-generated content

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Google signed the EU AI Act Code of Practice on 24 Jul 2026
This move aims to increase transparency in AI-generated content
The code of practice is a significant step towards regulating AI in the EU

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The EU AI Act Code of Practice is a crucial step towards ensuring accountability in AI
Google's decision to sign the code of practice demonstrates its commitment to transparency
This move may encourage other companies to follow suit

posts.caption: Google has taken a significant step towards transparency in AI-generated content by signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice. This move demonstrates the company's commitment to accountability in AI. Questions to consider: How will this move impact the development of AI in the EU? Will other companies follow Google's lead in signing the code of practice? #AIRegulation #EUAIACT #Google #Transparency
